Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

missBART 0.2.0

Speed

  • The samplers behind missBART1() (formerly missBARTprobit()), missBART2() and mvBART() are now written in C++ and are roughly 80 to 350 times faster than version 0.1.0; see the README for timings.
  • Results are reproducible with set.seed(), but the draws differ from those of version 0.1.0 for the same seed.

Changes to the samplers

These change the results relative to version 0.1.0.

  • Missing responses in partly observed rows. The Gaussian update of the missing responses (missBART1(), and missBART2() with include_y = FALSE) now conditions on the observed responses in the same row. Version 0.1.0, and Appendix C.1 of the paper as written, draw from the margin of the full-row distribution instead, which ignores the residual correlation between observed and missing responses of the same row. ymis_update = "marginal" restores the old behaviour. The two agree for univariate responses.
  • Node marginal likelihood. For more than one response, version 0.1.0 computed the quadratic form in the node marginal likelihood as sum(Sigma_inv %*% mu^2) rather than t(mu) %*% Sigma_inv %*% mu. The formula in the paper is now used.
  • Inverse-Wishart degrees of freedom in the parameter-expanded update of the probit correlation matrix are n + p + 1 (Talhouk et al., 2012, in the usual parameterisation) instead of n - p + 3.
  • Prior precisions of the probit coefficients. One precision is drawn for all covariates and one for all responses, as in Appendix B of the paper. Version 0.1.0 drew a separate value for every coefficient from the pooled full conditional.
  • Latent probit variables in missBART1() with more than one response are updated one coordinate at a time from their univariate truncated normal full conditionals, instead of by an exact draw from the multivariate truncated normal with TruncatedNormal::rtmvnorm() for every row.
  • Tree proposals. Split values are always drawn within the range of the covariate that is still available at the node. Version 0.1.0 used the interval (0, 1) after a change move at the root, and restricted trees whose deepest node is at depth 3 to grow and prune moves.
  • Trees can send missing covariate values left or right at every split, and missingness indicators are added only for covariates that have missing values.
  • mvBART() now respects hypers$kappa.

Interface

  • New name missBART1(), matching the paper; missBARTprobit() still works.
  • Fits have class "missBART" with print(), summary(), fitted(), predict() and coef() methods, and the helpers imputed_values(), completed_data() and varimp().
  • New arguments ymis_update, probit_prior (see probit_prior_list()), save_y_pred and save_z.
  • The posterior draws keep their names and list-of-matrices layout (y_post, y_pred, y_impute, new_y_post, B_post, R_post, z_post, …), so existing analysis scripts keep working, with these exceptions:
    • omega_post (also available as sigma_post) always holds full residual covariance matrices on the original scale. It used to hold only the variances when scale = TRUE and there was more than one response.
    • new_y_hat is new and holds the BART mean function at x_predict; new_y_post holds posterior predictive draws, as before.
    • var_imp is a matrix of split counts (iterations by predictors) rather than a list of tables; var_imp_reg is the same for the regression trees.
    • y_miss_accept holds one acceptance rate per missing value rather than an iterations-by-values matrix.
    • tau_b no longer has a leading row of NA.
    • pdp_out (missBART2(), univariate response) has one element per kept iteration, and no longer accumulates across iterations. missBART1() no longer returns pdp_out; compute the curves from B_post.
    • The trees and terminal node parameters (reg_trees, class_trees, reg_mu, class_mu, accepted_trees) are no longer returned.
  • The arguments true_trees_data, true_trees_missing, true_change_points and true_change_points_miss are ignored.
  • Dependencies on CholWishart, extraDistr, TruncatedNormal, Matrix, MASS and ggplot2 were dropped; Rcpp and RcppArmadillo were added.
  • The package has a pkgdown website (built into docs/) with a quick start vignette and further articles, including a re-run of the simulation studies in the paper.
  • The unexported plotting helpers plot_posterior() and plot_plant_posterior() were removed.
